friendly_name: Step enhancements and prompt fragments in the charter service
purpose_context: ADR-0066 lets a step enhancement add prompt fragments into named slots of a mission step's prompt. The contracts landed in #425; the service still drops step enhancements, never checks slots or fragments, and has no way to read the prompt a step really gets. This mission closes that gap (#424, #428) so packs such as open-packs' spdd pack can ship their guidance as fragments.
purpose_tldr: The charter service holds step enhancements and their prompt fragments, checks them, and serves the effective step prompt.
